verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent and entity-compliance service, so an API or webhook for monitoring entity standing and filing deadlines is a fair question to ask of it, and the axis applies. Both probes hit walls: robots.txt returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy host redirects into that same walled host. As a result, the pack documents no API, webhook, or deadline-alerting capability. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none", and confidence is only medium because no content was observed either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can watch entity standing and filing deadlines through an API or webhook and raise them before they lapse
